explanation: PDK/PDP-regulated inhibition of PDH (phosphorylation-limited pyruvate oxidation)
what_supports_it: Premise of the PDK-inhibitor and ketone-bypass hypotheses; glycolytic targets up in the organoid (E40); non-neural mouse and human fibroblast literature cited in the repository needs record; lactate up in the fibroblast line (E36) [Audit: this support list cites its own premise (circular).]
what_it_cannot_explain: PDK1 transcript not up in the organoid (E40); PDH activity showed no difference in the one human activity datum, which is non-neural (E36); no ISR signature (E41); no WWOX datum on any PDH phosphorylation site in neural cells
what_would_separate_it: Same-sample PDH state in matched neural cells: total E1-alpha protein, phosphorylation at all three sites, activity before and after dephosphorylation (E33, E34); then labelled-glucose flux

explanation: Lactate-side change: production, utilisation or redox state (NADH/NAD+) independent of PDH
what_supports_it: Fly: lactate and Ldh transcript up in the Wwox-RNAi + Abeta42 cell (E03, E07); partial climbing recovery with Ldh RNAi (E08); LDHA transcript up in organoid but age-confounded (E40); fibroblast lactate up with PDH activity unchanged (E36)
what_it_cannot_explain: Fly lactate does not rise without Abeta42 (E04); Ldh knockdown can be detrimental in other fly models (E10); a fall in Ldh is not needed for the rescue by Wwox overexpression (E19); organoid LDH-to-PDH ratio unshifted (E38)
what_would_separate_it: Lactate/pyruvate ratio with a redox read-out (NADH/NAD+) plus an LDH arm that changes lactate without changing PDH state; compare to the PDH-state result

explanation: Secondary or compensatory response to a stress state (Abeta42 load, high glucose, activity)
what_supports_it: Effect needs Abeta42 in the fly (E03, E11, E12); Abeta42 load itself rises with Wwox RNAi (E16); ATP unchanged, read by the authors as maintained supply (E17); high-glucose activation of WWOX in neuronal cells is a stress state (E26)
what_it_cannot_explain: Does not explain organoid transcripts without any stress; cannot say whether the response protects or harms (E10)
what_would_separate_it: Same genotype contrast with and without a defined stress (Abeta42 or high glucose) in one system; load measured in the same samples

explanation: Downstream respiratory or TCA limitation (complex I, TCA, 2-hydroxyglutarate-producing routes)
what_supports_it: Citrate and 2-hydroxyglutarate rise with Abeta42 in the fly (E20, E23); organoid oxidative panel flat (transcript) [Audit: E20 and E23 do not contain citrate; citrate rises with Abeta42 only in the Wwox-overexpression experiment (Padj 0.0667); E26 shows ATP and basal respiration changed by glucose alone, not 'unchanged'.]
what_it_cannot_explain: No respiratory flux anywhere in a WWOX-deficient neural system (E26 is a stress model, ATP production and basal respiration unchanged)
what_would_separate_it: OCR with substrate sets that enter before and after PDH (pyruvate versus a PDH-independent substrate), with acidification corrected for respiratory CO2 (E35)

explanation: Pyruvate transport (mitochondrial pyruvate carrier, monocarboxylate transporters) limiting oxidation
what_supports_it: Only that the pyruvate side is unmeasured: pyruvate is not among the identified features (E22) and may not have been tested (E02) [Audit: 'lysate PDH normal' overshoots: a phosphorylation state lost on homogenisation gives the same pattern.]
what_it_cannot_explain: No datum in any WWOX system; listed because it would mimic a PDH defect in a flux assay but not in a lysate PDH assay
what_would_separate_it: Lysate PDH activity normal with low cellular pyruvate oxidation points here; transporter expression and a transporter-independent substrate separate it

explanation: Energy demand and neuronal activity (activity-driven HIF/LDH, seizure state)
what_supports_it: Activity itself drives HIF-1alpha and LDHA in neurons (E42); the DEE phenotype includes abnormal firing
what_it_cannot_explain: No WWOX datum on firing and metabolism together
what_would_separate_it: Metabolic read-out under defined stimulation or silencing in the same cultures, with a firing or network outcome beside it

explanation: Composition, maturation and model conditions (not a metabolic block at all)
what_supports_it: Glycolytic genes fall with culture time in WWOX-unperturbed spheroids and the organoid KO is a mixed tissue (E40); fly head is a mixed pool (E01)
what_it_cannot_explain: Does not explain the fly interaction with Abeta42; says nothing about activity
what_would_separate_it: Matched-stage comparison with a composition read-out; single-cell or sorted-cell metabolite readings; for the fly, a cell-type resolved assay
